construction.clock: number of attempted local events, including no-operation events
construction.initial_loads: independent uniform integers 0..5; initial face flux zero
construction.scheduler: each attempt selects one of three seams and one of two coins uniformly

scope: Exact native repair and register dynamics on a declared closed two-face triangular cell; no transfer to the full federation or physical thermal abundances.

uniform_survival_bound.formula: Pr(outside terminal set after n attempts) <= (1/25)^floor(n/32) for every initial distribution
